bio: The steady stream of boats passing by provides a captivating backdrop for this bright and airy restaurant located at a point where three rivers meet. Large windows afford uninterrupted views. During the week, Arjan Kuipers serves up an appealing selection of simple dishes, including crispy battered fish and freshly cut chips. Alternatively, you can opt for a more ambitious and adventurous set menu. A variety of textures and international flavours are expertly combined, and the dishes are beautifully presented. With an accomplished chef at the helm, De Ertepeller offers the best of both worlds, and the quality is second to none....
